issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires implementing internal_calc as a private helper (not global), but the solution declares internal_calc as a global symbol ('global internal_calc') and exports it. This contradicts the specification and may confuse students about the intended visibility and linking behavior of the helper function.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the 'global internal_calc' directive from helloWorld.asm in the solution so internal_calc remains a private (non-exported) label. Alternatively, if exporting the symbol was intended, update the problem statement to allow/internal_calc to be global and clarify the reason.

issues.description: The template assembly uses the identifier 'ecc' as a register in add eax, ecc, while the problem statement explicitly instructs changing this to 'ecx' and the solution uses 'ecx'. This inconsistent/misspelled register name in the template prevents clear mapping from the task description to the starter code and will cause compilation failure, creating unnecessary cognitive load for students.
issues.suggestedFix: Replace the incorrect register name 'ecc' with the correct 'ecx' in helloWorld.asm (the add instruction) so the template, problem statement, and solution consistently refer to the same register identifier.
